description_en: Queries the detailed configurations of port forwarding rules for an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeLayer4Rules查询DDoS高防实例端口转发规则的详细配置
name: DescribeLayer4Rules

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源ip。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to query.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91478.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91478.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The forwarding protocol type. Valid values:
tcp: TCP protocol.
udp: UDP protocol
parameters.help_zh:
转发协议类型。取值：
tcp：表示TCP协议。
udp：表示UDP协议
parameters.name: forward_protocol

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paged query. Minimum value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。最小值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The number of results per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 50, which indicates up to 50 results per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含结果的数量。最大值为50，表示每页最多包含50个结果
parameters.name: page_size

Listeners.description_en: The detailed configurations of port forwarding rules, including the forward port, forwarding protocol, and addresses of the origin server
Listeners.description_zh: 端口转发规则的详细配置，包含转发端口、转发协议、源站地址等

BakMode.description_en:
The back-to-origin mode. Valid values:

0: default back-to-origin mode.
1: origin redundancy mode
BakMode.description_zh:
回源模式。取值：

0：表示默认回源模式。
1：表示主备回源模式

CurrentIndex.description_en:
The type of origin server that is currently in effect. Valid values:

1: The primary origin server settings are in effect. Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium forwards service traffic to the primary origin server IP addresses.
2: The secondary origin server settings are in effect. Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium forwards service traffic to the secondary origin server IP addresses
CurrentIndex.description_zh:
当前生效的源站类型。取值：

1：表示主源站设置生效（DDoS高防将业务流量转发到主源站IP地址）。
2：表示备源站设置生效（DDoS高防将业务流量转发到备源站IP地址）

Eip.description_en: The IP address of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance

IsAutoCreate.description_en:
Indicates whether the rule is automatically created. Valid values:

true: The rule is automatically created by Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium.
false: The rule is manually created
IsAutoCreate.description_zh:
该规则是否自动创建。取值：

true：表示该规则由DDoS高防自动创建。
false：表示该规则由您手动创建

PayloadRuleEnable.description_en:
The switch for the payload policy module. Valid values:

1: enabled.
0: disabled
PayloadRuleEnable.description_zh:
Payload策略模块开关。取值：

1：开启
0：关闭

ProxyEnable.description_en:
The traffic redirection switch. Valid values:
0: disabled.
1: enabled
ProxyEnable.description_zh:
引流开关。取值：
0 关闭。
1  开启

ProxyStatus.description_en:
The traffic redirection status. Valid values:

on: Traffic redirection is in effect.
off: Traffic redirection is not in effect
ProxyStatus.description_zh:
引流状态。取值：

on：引流生效
off：引流失效

RealServers.description_en: The list of origin server IP addresses

Remark.description_en: The remarks of the port forwarding rule
Remark.description_zh: 该端口转发规则的备注
